import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_shift_difference_tendsto
  {f : ℝ → ℝ} {B : ℝ}
  (hB : 0 < B)
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Tendsto (deriv f) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  ∀ h : ℝ, h ∈ Set.Ioc 0 B →
    Tendsto (fun x => f (x + h) - f x) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  intro h hh
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro ε hε
  have hεh : 0 < ε / h := div_pos hε hh.1
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hf (ε / h) hεh
  use max N₀ 1
  intro x hx
  have hx_N₀ : N₀ ≤ x := (max_le_iff.mp hx).1
  have hx_one : 1 ≤ x := (max_le_iff.mp hx).2
  have h_sub : Set.Icc x (x + h) ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have : 0 < y := by linarith [hy.1, hx_one]
    exact this
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc x (x + h)) := hfd.continuousOn.mono h_sub
  have hfd' : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo x (x + h)) :=
    hfd.mono (Set.Subset.trans Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self h_sub)
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hc_eq⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_slope f (lt_add_of_pos_right x hh.1) hfc hfd'
  have hc_ge : N₀ ≤ c := by linarith [hc.1]
  have hc_dist := hN₀ c hc_ge
  rw [_root_.dist_zero_right] at hc_dist ⊢
  have h_step : x + h - x = h := add_sub_cancel_left x h
  rw [h_step] at hc_eq
  have h_diff : f (x + h) - f x = deriv f c * h := by
    rw [hc_eq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hh.1)]
  rw [h_diff, _root_.norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hh.1)]
  have h_lt := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hc_dist hh.1
  rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ ε (ne_of_gt hh.1)] at h_lt
